title: Diverse, not Short: A Length-Controlled Data Selection Strategy for Improving Response Diversity of Language Models
authors_zh: Vijeta Deshpande, Debasmita Ghose, John D. Patterson, Roger Beaty, Anna Rumshisky
paper_type_zh: 长度控制的偏好数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 为开放式生成构造多样化偏好数据且需要防范指标驱动的长度偏差的读者。
one_line: Diverse-NS creates DPO pairs whose chosen response is more diverse and better scored than the rejected response without exploiting shorter length.
Diverse-NS 构造用于 DPO 的偏好对：入选回答更具多样性且质量更高，同时不靠缩短文本取得优势。
why: It shows that a diversity objective changes the training record in a harmful way unless selection explicitly equalizes response length.
inclusion_reason: It determines which synthetic chosen/rejected records enter DPO by jointly controlling diversity, quality, and response length.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference tuning can make language-model responses less varied even when it improves alignment. Existing diversity scores and reward models are negatively correlated with response length, so a pair-selection rule that simply maximizes a diversity metric can reward a shorter chosen answer rather than a genuinely more expressive one. The paper demonstrates this failure in the closest baseline, where chosen responses are roughly fifty words shorter on average.

The paper asks how to construct preference records that teach a model to produce more diverse creative responses without silently changing the target into brevity. Its solution is to generate an ordinary response and a controlled rewrite for the same prompt, then keep a pair only when the rewrite improves diversity and quality while remaining nearly the same length as the original.

偏好训练即使提升了对齐，也可能让语言模型的回答变得更单一。现有多样性分数和奖励模型都与回答长度负相关，因此只追求最大化多样性指标的成对选择规则，可能奖励一个更短的入选答案，而非一个真正更富表现力的答案。论文在最接近的基线中展示了这一失败：入选回答的平均长度大约短了五十个词。

论文要回答的是：如何构造偏好记录，使模型学会产生更多样的创意回答，同时不把训练目标悄悄变成简短。其解决方法是针对同一提示生成一个普通回答和一个受控改写，并且只保留那些改写在提升多样性和质量的同时，与原回答长度几乎相同的成对样本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Diverse-NS makes length a control variable in preference-data construction. A generated rewrite should be preferred not just because it has a higher entropy score, but because it is more diverse and higher quality than the ordinary response at comparable length. This changes the meaning of a preference label: it denotes diversity gain that cannot be explained away by giving the model fewer words to repeat.

The method also uses self-generated contrast rather than collecting a separate human-written target. An initial response represents the policy's natural tendency; a second call rewrites it under constraints intended to reduce repetition. Filtering then transforms the two responses into a quality-checked, length-matched learning signal. The resulting DPO record therefore attaches the training preference to a specific behavioral contrast—ordinary continuation versus a more varied continuation—rather than to a generic reward ranking.

Diverse-NS 将长度作为偏好数据构造中的控制变量。一个生成的改写之所以应被偏好，不能只因为它具有更高的熵分数，还应因为它在可比长度下比普通回答更多样、质量更高。这改变了偏好标签的含义：它表示无法用让模型少写一些词、从而减少重复来解释的多样性增益。

该方法还使用模型自行生成的对比，而不是收集一个独立的人类书写目标。初始回答代表策略的自然倾向；第二次调用在旨在减少重复的约束下改写它。过滤随后将两个回答转化为经过质量检查、长度匹配的学习信号。因此，最终的 DPO 记录把训练偏好绑定到一个具体的行为对比——普通续写与更丰富的续写——而不是绑定到泛化的奖励排序。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors create creative-writing prompts by sampling three-word sets, then use Llama-3.1-8B and Olmo-2-7B to produce a first five-sentence story and a second, constrained rewrite. In the final collection, each generator produces 200,000 prompt/first-response/second-response tuples from 20,000 prompts. The first response is provisionally rejected and the rewrite provisionally chosen, giving every record a naturally aligned contrast for preference learning.

A pair is retained only if the rewrite scores at or above the median first-response quality, exceeds the first response in ArmoRM quality and entropy, and differs by no more than five words. The authors sort retained pairs by entropy gain and use the top 3,000 for DPO, with the same budget applied to baselines. They then train the generating model on its own pairs and separately test whether Olmo-2-7B pairs can teach the larger Olmo-2-13B model.

作者通过抽取三词组合构造创意写作提示，然后让 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Olmo-2-7B 先生成第一篇五句故事，再生成第二篇受约束的改写。在最终收集中，每个生成器针对 20,000 条提示产生 200,000 个提示、第一回答、第二回答三元组。第一回答暂定为拒绝答案，改写暂定为入选答案，从而为每条记录提供了适合偏好学习的自然对比。

只有当改写的质量分数达到或高于第一回答质量的中位数、在 ArmoRM 质量和熵上都超过第一回答、且词数差不超过五个词时，样本对才会被保留。作者按熵增益排序保留对，并取前 3,000 对用于 DPO，同时对基线施加同样的预算。随后，他们用生成模型自己的样本对训练该模型，并另外检验 Olmo-2-7B 生成的样本对能否教会更大的 Olmo-2-13B 模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper first verifies the confound directly. Across its six text statistics, entropy and ArmoRM quality both have negative correlations with word count. After selection, the nearest diversity baseline has a chosen-minus-rejected length difference of minus 49.90 words, whereas Diverse-NS is minus 1.35 and its lightweight variant is minus 0.90. Thus the curated records preserve near length parity rather than selecting brevity as a shortcut.

With only 3,000 pairs, Diverse-NS improves diversity measurements across Divergent Associations, Persona Generation, Alternate Uses, and Creative Writing for Llama-8B, Olmo-7B, and Olmo-13B. For example, Llama-8B creative-writing DSI rises from 0.8515 to 0.8581 and four-gram diversity from 2.8550 to 2.9620. Human evaluators on creative writing give Diverse-NS win rates from 50.00% to 72.22% against the base model and from 51.52% to 72.73% against the closest baseline, depending on evaluator.

论文首先直接验证了这一混杂因素。在六种文本统计量中，熵和 ArmoRM 质量都与词数呈负相关。选择之后，最接近的多样性基线的入选答案减拒绝答案长度差为负 49.90 个词，而 Diverse-NS 为负 1.35，轻量变体为负 0.90。因此，筛选后的记录保持了近似的长度平衡，而没有把简短当作捷径选入。

仅用 3,000 个样本对，Diverse-NS 就在 Llama-8B、Olmo-7B 和 Olmo-13B 的发散联想、角色生成、替代用途和创意写作任务上提升了多样性测量。例如，Llama-8B 的创意写作 DSI 从 0.8515 上升到 0.8581，四元词组多样性从 2.8550 上升到 2.9620。对于创意写作，人类评审给出的 Diverse-NS 相对基础模型的胜率为 50.00% 至 72.22%，相对最接近基线的胜率为 51.52% 至 72.73%，具体数值因评审者而异。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The central novelty is to treat length matching as part of the preference-labeling contract, not merely as an evaluation correction. Earlier diversity-oriented selection can find high-entropy completions by favoring responses with fewer opportunities to repeat. Diverse-NS requires an improvement to survive a direct, same-prompt comparison under an explicit five-word length bound, so the selected record encodes a different training objective.

It also demonstrates a compact self-learning construction with a clear consumer: candidate generation, filtering, and DPO are linked in one record-level pipeline. The method does not claim that all creative answers have an objective ordering. Instead, it records a carefully bounded local preference between a default answer and a rewrite. The result is useful evidence that even a small set of pairs can change open-ended behavior when their selection criteria match the intended property.

核心新意在于把长度匹配当作偏好标注契约的一部分，而不只是一个评测修正。早期面向多样性的选择可以通过偏好词数更少、因而重复机会也更少的回答来找到高熵完成文本。Diverse-NS 要求一次提升必须在同提示的直接比较中、并在明确的五词长度界限下依然成立，因此入选记录编码的是不同的训练目标。

它还展示了一种紧凑的自学习构造，并明确了训练消费者：候选生成、过滤和 DPO 在同一条记录层面的流程中相连。该方法并不声称所有创意回答都存在客观排序，而是记录默认回答与改写之间一个经过细致约束的局部偏好。结果表明，只要选择标准与目标属性一致，即使是很小的一组样本对也可以改变开放式行为。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study uses entropy or TTR as a principal diversity signal, although neither alone captures all lexical, semantic, syntactic, and novelty dimensions. It focuses on short-story writing and one round of preference tuning, so transfer to broader tasks and repeated self-training remains unproven. Strict filtering can also leave a skew toward longer retained pairs despite within-pair parity. Finally, diversity is not a suitable sole objective where factual correctness is critical; the authors specifically caution against use for medical, legal, or scientific fact checking.
研究将熵或 TTR 作为主要多样性信号，但二者单独使用都不能覆盖词汇、语义、句法和新颖性的全部维度。它聚焦短故事写作和一轮偏好训练，因此能否迁移到更广泛任务以及重复自训练仍未得到证明。尽管样本对内部长度相近，严格过滤也可能使保留下来的样本对整体偏向较长文本。最后，当事实正确性至关重要时，多样性不适合作为唯一目标；作者特别警告不要将其用于医疗、法律或科学事实核查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this recipe when a post-training program wants more varied open-ended responses but suspects that its scorer rewards shortness. It supplies an auditable record schema and a simple eligibility rule for each chosen/rejected pair, then demonstrates a low-data DPO consumer. The same principle can be adapted to other controlled attributes, provided that teams identify the corresponding confound, independently test judge reliability, and do not interpret a creative-diversity signal as proof of factual quality.
当一个后训练项目希望获得更多样的开放式回答，却怀疑其评分器奖励了简短文本时，可以使用这一方案。它为每个入选、拒绝样本对提供可审计的记录结构和简单的准入规则，并展示了一个低数据量的 DPO 消费者。同一原则可迁移到其他受控属性，但团队应先找出相应的混杂因素、独立测试评审器可靠性，并且不要把创意多样性信号误解为事实质量的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Table 1 before the filtering rules: the negative length correlations explain why the length constraint is a training-data decision rather than cosmetic preprocessing. Then compare Table 2 with the final rule set in Section 4.2 and inspect the human evaluation alongside Table 3. For reuse, open the official dataset and repository to verify what fields and licenses are actually shipped; the paper's 3,000-pair experimental subset should not be confused with the broader released preference-data collection.
应在过滤规则之前先读表 1：负向的长度相关性说明，长度约束是一项训练数据决策，而不是外观上的预处理。然后将表 2 与第 4.2 节的最终规则集比较，并将人工评测与表 3 一并查看。若要复用，应打开官方数据集和代码库，核验实际提供了哪些字段和许可；论文实验中使用的 3,000 对子集不应与更广泛发布的偏好数据集合混为一谈。
